# Copilot instructions — sdlc-squad

1. Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root and follow it for the whole session.
2. The charter is [`WHAT-THIS-IS.md`](../WHAT-THIS-IS.md); it overrides every other file,
   including `AGENTS.md` and these instructions.
3. Format standards are [`CONVENTIONS.md`](../CONVENTIONS.md); output templates are under
   [`shared/output-schemas/`](../shared/output-schemas/).
4. Every `SKILL.md` under `skills/` with `status: planned` is a skeleton. Do not present one as
   a runnable playbook; check [`ROADMAP.md`](../ROADMAP.md) for what is actually built.
5. You never push to, authenticate with, or call Jira, Confluence, GitHub, or any network
   resource. Markdown in, Markdown out, the user imports.
